Ehrlich Yanai Rhee Chaney (EYRC) Architects is currently looking for enthusiastic and highly motivated Designers and/or licensed Architects to join our Commercial/Institutional Studio (Los Angeles, CA). Candidates should exhibit strong design and visualization skills, with the ability to execute creative ideas across all phases of a project. Candidates for this position should be able to meet the following qualifications:
Founded in 1979, Ehrlich Yanai Rhee Chaney Architects (EYRC) is a California-based practice with studios in Los Angeles and San Francisco. The firm is a team of 30+ architects and designers led by six Partners working across civic, education, commercial, student housing, cultural, adaptive reuse, and private residential projects. EYRC received the AIA National Firm Award in 2015, along with 12 national AIA awards, the 2003 AIA California Firm of the Year, and more than 200 additional honors. The firm is a certified Minority Business Enterprise (MBE) and Small Business (SB). EYRC practices in a diverse, collaborative environment and offers comprehensive health, retirement, and vacation benefits. This is an in-person position at our Los Angeles office with a Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday in-office schedule.
Communication via email only.
Please email resumes, letters of interest, and samples of work to Hiring Manager with the subject heading "Employment Inquiry – Designer / Architect LA" to: [email protected].
